name: BenchPreS
description:
🪑🏋️ BenchPreS: A Benchmark for Context-Aware Personalized Preference Selectivity of Persistent-Memory LLMs
	

Paper
BenchPreS is a benchmark for evaluating whether persistent-memory LLMs can selectively apply or suppress stored user preferences based on communicative context. It pairs 10 user profiles (each containing factual and preference attributes such as humorous tone or bold formatting) with 39 recipient–task contexts across five formal communication domains (e.g., messages to… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/sangyon/BenchPreS.
evaluation_method: accuracy / task_success_rate (whether model applies or suppresses stored preference appropriately given context)
reputation: A recent, specialized benchmark hosted on Hugging Face aimed at research on persistent-memory LLMs and preference selectivity; modest adoption so far within alignment and personalization research.
